answer: Delivery-commitment bond: each identity files one measurable delivery. It locks a 70-credit bond on a lagoon plot, naming a vertex and quantity under umber seal. Auditors re-weigh the catch at the vertex; a shortfall or reused umber seal burns the bond. Rented catches fail: the seal binds catch to key. First filing costs 34; the k-th 34+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,031,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 34 once; a clean delivery returns it.
